Implemented the requested Linux Settings UI changes in `lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart`:

- When the selected **screen** is **Cassette**, the cassette variant controls now render **immediately below** the `screen` row (instead of being in the later “DISPLAY” section).
- Renamed the cassette “color-changing” variant setting label to exactly **`color scheme`** (the control’s value still cycles exactly as before).
- Preserved the existing behavior for the cassette controls (variant cycle, text size slider, and haptics toggle).

Screenshot (Cassette selected; shows `screen` immediately followed by `color scheme`):
- `.tmp/agent_shots/cassette_settings_region.png`

Also ran:
- `flutter analyze` ✅ (no issues found)
